_comment: Site list for `prepare.py --config`. Copy this, point the paths at your own data.
Each site needs three layers on the same ground: an orthomosaic, the digitised stem
polygons, and the AOI (the windthrow polygon, `*_AOE.shp` in the WINMOL corpus).
Sampling never leaves the AOI, because outside it the stems are real but were never
digitised -- tiles from there would teach the model that stems are background.
extent_m sets the tile footprint, and effective ground resolution is extent_m/tile_px.
At 15 m / 512 px that is 2.93 cm/px, which must match the tile_size the WINMOL Analyzer
is run with. Use native_px instead of extent_m to cut at the orthomosaic's own
resolution, which is what the multi-scale recipes (--recipe jitter) train on.
block_size_m controls the leak-free split under --strategy blocks: the site is cut into
blocks of that size and whole blocks go to train/val/test. It must comfortably exceed
extent_m * sqrt(2) (the rotated tile's half-diagonal, either side of a shared edge), or
tiles on opposite sides of a block boundary can overlap and leak. Small sites may have
no usable block at all -- prepare.py says so rather than silently contributing nothing.
